header: One panel at a time, behind a row of buttons
lead: A tab strip over a single visible panel. Reach for it when a page would otherwise scroll forever, and for the audience switch every product page eventually needs.

panels.title: All panels in the markup
panels.text: Nothing is fetched and nothing starts hidden, so a search engine, a printer and a reader with scripting off all get the whole band.

panels.title: Arrow keys and roving focus
panels.text: Left and right move between tabs, Home and End jump to the ends, and only the selected tab is a tab stop.

panels.title: The strip scrolls, never wraps
panels.text: Six tabs on a narrow screen scroll sideways, because a second row of tabs reads as a second group of them.
